build_compression_solver: build a CompressionSolver instance from an OmegaConf config to train an EncodecModel for audio compression
run_step_training: run a single training or validation step on a batch of audio data with adversarial and auxiliary losses
load_model_from_checkpoint: load a CompressionModel from a checkpoint path or pretrained model name using model_from_checkpoint
load_wrapped_model_from_checkpoint: load a wrapped CompressionModel from a checkpoint path with custom wrapping config using wrapped_model_from_checkpoint
evaluate_audio_reconstruction: evaluate audio reconstruction quality by computing VISQOL and SISNR metrics between predicted and ground truth audio
